# WAN-derived source

This directory contains the WAN modules imported by DynamicWAM. They were
adapted from the Wan2.2 source used by the Efficient-WAM training stack and
remain under the bundled Apache-2.0 license.

Model weights and tokenizer assets are not stored in this repository. Their
Hugging Face revision, filenames, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes are pinned in
`manifests/external_assets.json`.
